roadmap_fit: Fresh frequent 1h cross-asset information-diffusion candidate after rejecting duplicate compression and pullback proposals.
deferred: market-row, outcome, packet, identity-ledger or sealed-holdout access
parameter, side, symbol, regime, window or management selection
hypothesis: After removing an alt perpetual's contemporaneous BTC beta, a large completed BTCUSDT hourly impulse predicts a delayed same-direction residual response in PIT-eligible alts whose frozen pre-decision lag coefficient is positive and whose impulse-hour residual has not already consumed that forecast.

metadata_sources_only: research_evidence/prereg metadata across current and historical Git refs
selection_provenance.duplicate_search: Metadata-only searches across the current tree and Git history found BOL-1H BTC aggressor-flow lead-lag, DSR-1H BTC-neutral residual reversion, C52 own-symbol volume-return lead-lag, C258 cross-sectional relative-strength continuation and time-series momentum. No frozen candidate estimates a symbol-specific lagged BTC coefficient after removing contemporaneous BTC beta and then trades its unconsumed forecast after a completed BTC price impulse.
selection_provenance.not_holdout_rescue: No C259 market row, signal, return, outcome, packet, identity ledger or sealed-holdout artifact was opened. No rule was inferred from BOL-1H, DSR-1H, C258 or any later-period outcome.

economic_distinction.from_bol_1h: BOL-1H thresholds archived one-minute BTC aggressor imbalance plus a fixed BTC price move and admits a target merely because its same-hour raw move is flat. C259 uses no trades or taker-flow stream: it estimates separate contemporaneous beta and lag-response coefficients from prior 1h returns and admits only a positive statistically identified, still-unconsumed residual forecast.
economic_distinction.from_dsr_1h: DSR-1H fades cross-sectional six-hour residual extremes after recovery during elevated dispersion. C259 follows a one-hour delayed response to a completed BTC impulse; it has no cross-sectional residual rank, dispersion event or reversion entry.
economic_distinction.from_c258: C258 pairs relative 24h leaders and laggards and never uses BTC to form its score. C259 is single-symbol time-series lead-lag, separately judged by side, and conditions on a completed BTC impulse.
economic_distinction.from_c52: C52 estimates whether an alt's own lagged quote-volume change predicts its own return. C259 uses BTC return as the external lagged predictor after contemporaneous market residualization and volume only for liquidity admission.

authority.future_pin_rule: After all four authority-v6 outputs independently pass and protected-merge, and before any market or outcome read, one mechanical amendment may bind their exact byte hashes/content digests and accepted protected head. It may change no hypothesis, signal, side, universe, execution, risk, cost, split, gate, multiplicity or PAPER term; any other change creates a new numbered candidate.
authority.pre_market_gate: Validate the authority-v6 plan byte hash, output byte hashes/content digests, cutoff-exclusive rule, PIT-v9 weekly cells, filter-v4 fold bindings and coverage-v4 ZERO_GUARANTEED_PERIOD_GAPS before opening any 1h bar, mark or funding row.
authority.membership: At each completed 1h decision close d, use the PIT-v9 crypto book from the greatest weekly Monday cell with monday_ms<=d, preserving artifact order, then apply filter-v4 for the fold. BTCUSDT is the external benchmark and cannot be traded by C259. Current membership, archive availability, survivor filtering and future cells are forbidden.
authority.availability: Use only completed exact-timestamp 1h klines, causal mark closes and funding rows available by the event. Never forward-fill, backfill, interpolate, compress time, synthesize zero funding or bridge a missing bar.

splits.boundary_rule: Every development, fold and holdout window starts flat and resets all beta, lag, ATR, liquidity and regime statistics. Prior rows may not warm a window or contribute a signal, fill, funding or P&L.
splits.one_shot_rule: Development can only reject C259. Each surviving side runs unchanged through all three forward folds once; a forward survivor spends the sealed holdout once under independent exact-head control. No threshold, side, symbol, regime, coefficient, holding period, stop, cost, capital slice or gate may be tuned or rescued.

signal.decision_clock: At completed canonical 1h close d, calculate only from candles whose close timestamp is <=d. Any signal can fill only at the next canonical 1h open strictly after d.
signal.returns: For BTCUSDT and each eligible alt, r_t=log(close_t/close_t_minus_1h) on exact contiguous canonical timestamps. Nearest-bar substitution and compressed-time returns are forbidden.
signal.estimation_window: For each alt at d, use exactly the 720 paired hourly observations s=d-720h..d-1h, excluding d. Require all 720 contiguous finite BTC and alt returns; otherwise that symbol is ineligible. No estimator state crosses a split boundary.
signal.contemporaneous_beta: beta0=math.fsum(r_alt_s*r_btc_s)/math.fsum(r_btc_s*r_btc_s) over the frozen window. A non-finite or non-positive denominator refuses the symbol. residual_s=r_alt_s-beta0*r_btc_s.
signal.lag_model: For s=d-719h..d-1h set x_s=r_btc_s_minus_1h and y_s=residual_s. With n=719, xx=math.fsum(x_s*x_s), gamma=math.fsum(y_s*x_s)/xx, error_s=y_s-gamma*x_s, sse=math.fsum(error_s*error_s), sigma2=sse/718, se_gamma=sqrt(sigma2/xx), and t_gamma=gamma/se_gamma, evaluated in that order in IEEE-754 binary64. Non-finite values, xx<=0, sse<0 or se_gamma<=0 refuse the symbol.
signal.btc_impulse: scale=median(abs(r_btc_s)) over the 168 completed hours ending d-1h. Require finite scale>0. Positive impulse: r_btc_d>=max(0.0075,3.0*scale). Negative impulse: r_btc_d<=-max(0.0075,3.0*scale). Equality qualifies; no other BTC hour signals.
signal.unconsumed_forecast: At d compute residual_d=r_alt_d-beta0*r_btc_d and forecast=gamma*r_btc_d. Long requires gamma>=0.10, t_gamma>=2.0, positive BTC impulse, forecast>=0.0028 and residual_d<=0.25*forecast. Short requires gamma>=0.10, t_gamma>=2.0, negative BTC impulse, forecast<=-0.0028 and residual_d>=0.25*forecast. Sides are separate hypotheses and cannot pool or rescue each other.
signal.liquidity: Decision-hour quote_volume must be finite, positive and >=the median of the preceding 24 completed hours excluding d. Causal 24h quote notional must be >=100 times proposed raw entry notional; otherwise record IMPACT_INFEASIBLE before entry.
signal.ordering_and_capacity: Within a side, sort eligible symbols by abs(forecast-residual_d) descending then symbol ascending. Admit at most three symbols at d, skipping occupied or infeasible symbols without backfill from another side. A symbol may have at most one C259 position.
signal.anti_lookahead: The impulse-hour alt return is used only to measure response already consumed; d is excluded from every coefficient and every scale/liquidity baseline, while its completed OHLC is included exactly once in causal ATR24. Entry reference, exchange rounding and P&L begin at the strictly later open.

execution.entry: Enter the admitted alt side at the first canonical 1h open strictly after d. Apply frozen adverse slippage once. Missing next-open authority makes the candidate INCOMPLETE.
execution.atr: ATR24 is Wilder RMA alpha=1/24 over completed contiguous bars, seeded by the first 24 true ranges inside each split and updated through completed decision bar d exactly once. No entry-open or later value enters the stop distance.
execution.protection: Place a reduce-only 2ATR stop from the raw next-open reference before exposure can be counted. A long gap stop uses min(stop,bar_open); short uses max(stop,bar_open); a non-gap range touch uses stop. Stop wins any same-bar target or scheduled-exit ambiguity.
execution.exit: Exit at 2R target, protective stop, or the first canonical open at least 12 hours after actual entry, whichever occurs first under the frozen ambiguity rule. No partial, trailing stop, signal exit, pyramid or DCA.
execution.failure_accounting: A rejected or uncertain entry is a pre-entry skip only when zero quantity is accepted. If any quantity is accepted without confirmed protection, classify PROTECTION_FAILURE, keep the lot conservatively protected where possible, flatten at the next canonical open, include all actual cashflows as a closed loss-row in every gate, and make the whole candidate INCOMPLETE. No accepted exposure or cost may be dropped.
execution.exchange_rules: Apply point-in-time PRICE_FILTER, MARKET_LOT_SIZE, MIN_NOTIONAL and maximum quantity to every entry and exit. Floor quantity with exact Decimal arithmetic; never round up or use current exchangeInfo.

sizing.capital_selection_rule: Only the complete 2000 USD replay admits/skips primary attempts and passes/rejects gates. The 1000/3000/4000 replays are replay-local feasibility diagnostics; they cannot veto, select, rescue, replace, average with or alter the 2000 USD trade set or verdict.
sizing.book_equity: Before each admission, book_equity=settled cash plus causal marked P&L of existing C259 positions using the latest verified mark close strictly before the entry open. Missing or non-positive equity/mark is INCOMPLETE.
sizing.risk_cash: requested_risk_cash=0.01*book_equity. Continuous quantity=requested_risk_cash divided by the sum of raw 2ATR stop loss per unit and stressed nonnegative entry plus stop fee/slippage drag per unit. Every denominator must be finite and positive.
sizing.rounding: q=floor(continuous_quantity/stepSize)*stepSize using exact Decimal. Recompute raw notional and stressed stop loss; require min/max quantity, minNotional, raw gross<=0.50*book_equity, actual_initial_risk_cash<=requested_risk_cash and impact/liquidity admission. Never increase or search for a favorable quantity.
sizing.primary_gate: All headline frequency, expectancy, PF, drawdown, bootstrap and promotion values come only from the 2000 USD primary replay.

risk.side_isolation: Long and short maintain separate performance gates and trial counts. They share only mechanical account capacity; one side cannot rescue, offset or promote the other.
risk.correlation_disclosure: Report same-hour cluster size, symbol/side concentration, pairwise return correlation, BTC beta, impulse clustering and overlap with BOL-1H, DSR-1H and C258.

costs.pnl_rule: movement_cash is signed; funding_cash is signed with credits positive; fee_drag and slippage_drag are finite nonnegative sums over every fill. net_cash=movement_cash+funding_cash-fee_drag-slippage_drag. Reference-price movement and execution drag are disjoint and each cost is charged exactly once.
costs.funding: Book every verified Binance funding event during exposure using signed side quantity and the last verified 1h mark close strictly before funding time. Missing, duplicate or non-causal funding/mark authority makes the candidate INCOMPLETE; never assume zero.
costs.impact: Require proposed raw entry notional<=1% of the causal prior-24h mean hourly quote volume and charge impact_drag_bps=10*sqrt(participation/0.01), capped at 10 bps per fill. Missing volume refuses entry. Impact is nonnegative and never improves a fill.
costs.cost_admission: The 2ATR stop distance must be at least five times base 14 bp round-trip cost and abs(forecast) must be at least twice base round-trip cost before rounding.
costs.stress: Replay the identical admitted primary trade set with 10 bp adverse slippage per fill plus the same fees, funding and impact; stress may never change admission, improve a fill or remove a trade.

regime.definition: At each decision d, compute BTCUSDT EMA200 from contiguous completed 1h closes inside the same split, seeded with the first 200 closes and updated through d. Label BTC_ABOVE_OR_ON_EMA200 when close_d>=EMA200_d, else BTC_BELOW_EMA200.
regime.causality: The exact BTC d close is available at decision time; no later close or state crosses a split. Missing/non-finite BTC data resets warm-up and prevents admission.
regime.attribution: Freeze regime at entry decision and retain it through close. Every normal or failure row must have exactly one label.

stress-cost aggregate mean net R>0 and profit factor>1.02
no symbol contributes more than 25% of sum(abs(symbol net R)); zero denominator fails

holdout_pass_all_required_per_side: at least 20 complete closed trades across at least 6 symbols

drawdown_tiers.elevated: 15R<max drawdown<=30R and total net R/max drawdown>=1.5
drawdown_tiers.high: 30R<max drawdown<=60R, total net R/max drawdown>=2.0, stress net R/stress max drawdown>=1.0, and future PAPER risk multiplier<=min(0.5,15/max_drawdown_R)

required_report: scheduled, eligible, admitted, skipped, failed and closed counts by side
gross/net R, mean R, PF, win rate, drawdown, recovery and return/drawdown ratio
nonnegative fee, slippage and impact drags plus signed funding
fold, week, month, side, symbol, regime and capital diagnostics
coefficient, t-stat, impulse, residual-consumption and liquidity distributions without post-result subgroup selection
base/stress results, bootstrap interval/p-value, authority gaps, correlations and full trial ledger

statistics.ordered_unit: closed trade within one side ordered by entry timestamp then symbol
statistics.statistic: mean after-cost net R per closed trade
statistics.method: Politis-Romano stationary bootstrap with fixed draws
statistics.prng: numpy 2.5.3 numpy.random.Generator(numpy.random.PCG64(seed)); draw float64 uniforms with size=(resamples,n,2) in C order; PCG64 only.
statistics.fixed_draw: For each replicate and observation consume two uniforms. At j=0 choose floor(u_index*n). At j>0 restart at floor(u_index*n) when u_restart<1/21, otherwise advance previous index modulo n while still consuming u_index. Consume exactly resamples*n*2 uniforms.
statistics.p_value: Center observations by observed mean; p=(1+count(bootstrap_mean>=observed_mean))/(10000+1), inclusive upper tail.
statistics.confidence_interval: Use uncentered draws and numpy.quantile(method='linear') at 0.025 and 0.975.

multiplicity.ledger_rule: Append every scheduled decision, zero-trade hour, skip, attempt, failure, base/stress row and rejection. Prior and rejected candidates remain counted.
multiplicity.no_rescue: Each side passes independently. Pooling sides or selecting a symbol, regime, month, fold, coefficient slice, capital diagnostic or baseline is forbidden; any rule change is a new numbered candidate.

prerequisites_per_side: development, all forward gates and one independently spent sealed holdout pass unchanged
independent exact-head reproduction passes with byte-bound authorities
runtime causal-parity, filter, protection, restart and rollback drills pass
isolated C259 side book and immutable cohort evidence are ready
paper_admission.bounded_canary: Start each independently qualified side at 0.25R per position, maximum two C259 positions and 0.50R total C259 open risk. Apply any stricter frozen drawdown multiplier. No mainnet authority.
paper_admission.paper_transfer_gate: For a side, require at least 50 complete measured closes over at least 14 Cairo days, positive actual-cost mean net R, PF>1.05, no unprotected lot, no incomplete cost row and no risk/protection breach. PAPER cannot rescue a historical failure.
paper_admission.rollback: Unknown account state, protection failure, authority drift, incomplete costs or causal mismatch disables new C259 entries immediately while existing testnet exposure remains protected and managed.
